# gitcode-pr-metadata

[中文手册](../../../docs/zh/actions/gitcode-pr-metadata.md) · [English guide](../../../docs/en/actions/gitcode-pr-metadata.md)

查询 PR 的目标分支、来源分支和完整提交 SHA，并确认 PR 仍然开启。后续构建可以按明确的源码版本执行。

Reads the PR target branch, source branch and full commit SHA and verifies that the PR remains open. Downstream builds can use an explicit source revision.
